result.success_criterion_note: MITM collisions found at O(C*sqrt(cs)) with C~50-90, NOT O(sqrt(cs)). The birthday paradox bound underestimates actual cost due to volcano graph slow mixing.
result.volcanic_mixing_note: The 3-isogeny volcano graph has hierarchical structure (surface + floors) with slow mixing time. Random walks on the volcano require ~50-90x sqrt(class_size) steps to collide, not sqrt(class_size). This is not a failure of the MITM but a failure of the expander-graph assumption in the H-OIFP-097d1a statement.

dominated_by: L[1/2] class group index calculus for OIFP at large p

sota_delta.note: OIFP MITM confirmed valid but with large constant C~50-90 vs ideal birthday bound
